B1_EXC.name: B1_EXC
B1_EXC.description:
Excessive errors on the regenerator section (B1). This alarm is generated when the received SDH signals 
degrade and the B1 bit errors on the regenerator section exceed the threshold.
possible_causes: (reported from the client side): The input signals on the client side contain B1 bit errors.
(reported from the client side): The board that reports this alarm is faulty.
(reported from the WDM side): The receive side of the local station (Station B) is faulty. ===== PAGE 179 ===== OptiX OSN 9800 Product Documentation 2026-04-22 177
(reported from the WDM side): The attenuation of the received signals is excessively high; the fiber or connector is not clean.
(reported from the WDM side): The transmit side of the opposite station (Station A) is faulty.
B1_EXC.impact:
The B1 bit errors in the service signals received by a board exceed the B1 bit error threshold set for the 
board. The alarm affects the QoS of the service signals.

BOOTROM_BAD.impact:

normally started.

BP_ODU_LOFLOM.name: BP_ODU_LOFLOM
BP_ODU_LOFLOM.description:
BP_ODU_LOFLOM indicates the loss of ODUk frames and multiframes in the backplane direction of an 
OTN line board. This alarm is reported when the frame header information of the source board and sink 
board (the line board that reports the alarm) does not match.
possible_causes: The sink board is faulty.
The source board is faulty.
The cross-connect board is faulty.
The rate modes of corresponding channels on the source and sink boards are inconsistent.
BP_ODU_LOFLOM.impact: The OTN service that traverses this line board is interrupted or has a bit error.

CLIENT_PORT_PS.name: CLIENT_PORT_PS
CLIENT_PORT_PS.description:
Client-side 1+1 protection switching. This alarm is generated when a client 1+1 protection group 
undergoes protection switching and the active channel is switched from the working channel to the

LPT_ACTIVE.name: LPT_ACTIVE
LPT_ACTIVE.description:
This alarm indicates that LPT switching occurred. The data equipment itself has protection schemes. Hence, 
the protection provided by the WDM equipment is not needed. However, the WDM equipment is needed 
for informing the data equipment about the faults in the transmission layer. In this way, the switching 
would be triggered for the data equipment. The alarm is generated when switching is triggered.
possible_causes: The input signals on the client side are missing or the local board detects a LINK_ERR or L_SYNC alarm.
An REM_SF alarm is generated on the client side of the local board because equipment at the opposite station malfunctions.

When the WDM equipment receives data services and the OTN frames are transmitted on the WDM side, this alarm may be triggered by the R_LOS, OTUk_AIS, OTUk_LOF, ODUk_PM_AIS, ODUk_PM_OCI, ODUk_PM_LCK, ODUk_TCMn_AIS, ODUk_TCMn_OCI, or ODUk_TCMn_LCK alarm on the WDM side.
When the WDM equipment receives data services and the SDH frames are transmitted on the WDM side, this alarm may be triggered by the R_LOS or R_LOF alarm on the WDM side.
Regarding to separation of the tributary board from the line board, if the cross-connection configuration does not exist, the alarm is generated.
LPT_ACTIVE.impact:
When this alarm is generated, services will be interrupted if no alternative route is available. If an 
alternative route is available, the services will be automatically switched to the available route, and a 
message will be generated, prompting the user to remove the fault.
